prerequisite: IntersectionDetailSetup.Apply(), then StreetLifeSetup.Apply(). The accompanying IntersectionDetailSetup revision changes only metric UV orientation and near-facade window size variation.
scope: Nine existing intersection facades, their recessed arcade shop fronts, and material transitions on neighbouring source facades within approximately 44 metres of the intersection.
accuracy: A nearby-photo-informed visual interpretation, not photogrammetry or a measured reconstruction. Shop identities, products, prices, signs, material palettes, weathering and furnishing positions are original fictional choices. Existing OSM centreline and estimated building envelopes are preserved.

procedural_assets.MosaicSand: Original 512 px ceramic albedo, normal and metallic/smoothness maps; 150 x 75 mm tiles, approximately 3 mm joints, individual-tile colour variation.
procedural_assets.MosaicSage: Original 512 px grey-green ceramic map set with the same metric tiling.
procedural_assets.MosaicRose: Original 512 px muted clay-grey ceramic map set with the same metric tiling.
procedural_assets.ArcadeTile: Original 512 px 300 mm square paving map set with subdued joints and restrained surface variation.
procedural_assets.DrainPatina: Original procedural feathered-alpha drip mask, placed sparsely below sills and alongside pipes instead of repeating dirt over entire walls.
procedural_assets.StreetLetteringAtlas: Immutable glyph atlas baked from the project's OFL-licensed Noto Sans TC font. Only the original shop captions and menu lettering are used; text geometry is combined into one material batch and uses StreetLabelDepth.shader for depth testing and back-face culling.
procedural_assets.reuse: Neighbouring-facade transitions use the project's existing concrete_wall_003 diffuse texture at low detail strength. Font is the existing Noto Sans TC; its OFL and existing third-party texture notices remain applicable.

visual_features: Traditional Chinese original fascia lettering, category subtitles and five two-sided arcade blade signs
Visible shop-depth planes, side reveals, warm ceiling fixtures, partially raised shutters and narrow glazed entrances
Breakfast/noodle counters, tea jars and cups, appliance shelves, a repair workbench and grocery display crates
Small price boards and wall notices sized for the shop entrance rather than billboard scale
Sparse potted plants, breakfast stools, slatted drink crates, bottles and supply boxes within the arcade
Window width and height variation and metric wall UVs so tile courses keep their orientation on both road sides
Moderate grey-green, sand and muted clay ceramic tones and a gradual transition into the existing block

reference_photographs.author: Kiyoteru Awaji
reference_photographs.observation: Narrow layered shop fronts, steel awning supports, utility conduits, planting, small projecting signs, patches of weathering and a clear walking strip. This is a nearby lane, not the exact reconstructed corner.

reference_photographs.author: Solomon203
reference_photographs.observation: Ground-floor shop display depth, framed serving windows, restrained wall notices, utility-meter scale and practical surface finishes visible behind the vehicle.

photograph_use: Visual reference only. No source photograph pixels are included in any generated texture, mesh or build.

technical_constraints.batching: Geometry grouped by material, including shelves, plants, counters, glazing and signs. Lettering uses one baked glyph mesh batch and an immutable Noto Sans TC atlas with a dedicated depth-tested alpha-cutout shader; it does not use the GUI font material or require a runtime text-refresh script.
technical_constraints.reversibility: Apply replaces the named root deterministically. Remove restores former facade and neighbour material assignments and previous fascia text. Generated source assets remain for reuse.
